data.name: The Backrooms: Lost to the Dark
data.detailed_description:
The Backrooms: Lost to the Dark puts you and six other players into an unsettling maze: The Backrooms. Six Players take on the role of the Explorers, working together to try unlock and break open new areas of the map, looking for items, and most importantly: FIND A WAY OUT. However, one player takes on the role of the Monster, hunting everyone down and stopping them from escaping.

With every Match being a tense game of cat and mouse, Explorers need to rely teamwork, and clever use of their unique abilities to survive. The Monster has its own set of special powers to hunt and kill the Explorers.

With multiple maps, a selection of Explorers and Monsters to choose from, and customization, to make every match feel different. You’ll never know what’s waiting for you.

Key Features:

- 6v1 multiplayer asymmetrical horror, six Explorers team up against a single Monster.

- Unique abilities to incentivize Gameplay, every character has their own special powers, enabling for many different playstyles.

- Multiple maps and characters, unlock even more as you go.

- Dynamic exploration, unlock blocked areas to discover new paths, or walk straight into danger. The choice is YOURS.

- Items and other pickups, use whatever you find to survive, from traps to keys.

- Rewarding Progression, Level up, earn rewards, and increase your matchmaking rank.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 3600 or i5-9400F
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 Super or RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Please make sure you are on the latest graphics drivers.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 5600 or i7-12400F
  • Graphics: RTX 4070 SUPER or RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Please make sure you are on the latest graphics drivers.

content_descriptors.notes: The Backrooms: Lost to the Dark contains depictions of violence and Horror Themes. Players will experience disturbing imagery, jump scares and and graphic violence when characters are attacked or killed. However, there are NO depictions sexual acts, drug or alcohol use, or self-harm.
